# Sky

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/sky/sky.h`](../../../src/logic/sky/sky.h) · Described in `data/world.json`

Host context variable: the time of day and the place, from which the sun, the moon and the sky follow.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `time` | `float` | hours, 0 to 24 (default 10.3349: the sun at normalize(0.5, 1, 0.5)) |
| `day_length` | `float` | seconds of play for a day; 0: the sun is stopped |
| `latitude` | `float` | degrees (42.8, Tautavel) |
| `declination` | `float` | degrees: the season (14.787) |

## Notes

Set by the Sky system (constructor) and moved by its tick; the renderer's Lights emplaces a default one when a scene has no Sky system. skyLight(Sky) gives the directional light, sky colours and ambient light (mirrored by the shaders). Read by Lights, TreeShade, the debug menu (which may change the time).

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: Lights, TreeShade. Written by: DebugMenu, Sky. Created by: Lights, Sky. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick | time of the day, day_length, declination sliders; skyLight() for sun or moon |
| [Sky](../systems/Sky.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | constructor | insert_or_assign with the scene's time, latitude, declination and day length |
| [Sky](../systems/Sky.md) | system | Host | **readwrite** | tick | time += dt x 24 / day_length, wrapped to [0, 24) |
| [Lights](../systems/service-Lights.md) | service | Host | **read+create** | constructor, update | Emplaced when the scene has no Sky system; the light, sky colours and ambient light of the time of day. |
| [TreeShade](../systems/service-TreeShade.md) | service | Host | **read** | constructor, update (followLight) | Direction of the light that casts the shadows. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md)**
  - One ImGui window "Dynamical" (needs UI before it).
  - Changing the soil or grass height-map parameters makes SoilMaps / GrassPass bake their per-chunk maps again (they watch RenderSettings).
  - Creates torch entities and dynamic boxes (Jolt bodies through RigidBodySys) on button presses; destroys every PointLight entity on "No torches".
- **[Lights](../systems/service-Lights.md)**
  - Writes the mapped lights uniform buffer of the frame and sets Context::lights_buffers.
- **[Sky](../systems/Sky.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[TreeShade](../systems/service-TreeShade.md)**
  - Signals: connects on_construct<Plant> and on_destroy<Plant> (disconnected in the destructor).
  - GPU: uploads a new 2048x2048 R8 image through Transfer whenever a plant came or went or the light moved (1 degree, 10 with ray tracing); old ones kept for the frames in flight; sets Context::tree_shade_view and tree_shade_sampler.
